findings.currentPlan: Omgevingsplan gemeente Halderberge CVDR696469 remains the controlling address-specific spatial source.
findings.housingAllocation: Huisvestingsverordening gemeente Halderberge is current and is focused on allocation/priority for specified housing categories; it is not used as a generic room-rental/splitting permit regime unless an operative provision says so.
findings.ordinaryRoomRentalAndSplitting: Repeated targeted official-source searches did not positively expose a current municipality-wide standalone generic policy for ordinary kamerverhuur or woningsplitsing. Therefore no other-municipality rule is imported and no generic permission/prohibition is invented; concrete permission remains address/current-plan dependent.
findings.labourMigrants: Halderberge has a separate policy history and current municipal programme context for humane housing of labour migrants. VTH policy explicitly refers to the 2016 policy note on labour-migrant housing, and 2025 municipal programme material still treats humane labour-migrant accommodation as a live policy topic. This is retained as a distinct target-group branch and not generalized to ordinary room rental.
findings.applicationRoute: Municipality requires first checking the Omgevingsplan and the Omgevingsloket Vergunningcheck. A spatial/social initiative can be submitted before the final permit to assess desirability and feasibility. A formal omgevingsvergunning is submitted through Omgevingsloket with DigiD or eHerkenning.
conceptDocuments: building elevations existing/new situation scale 1:100 with colours/materials for building plans
floor plans existing/new situation scale 1:100 with dimensions
cadastral site drawing scale 1:1,000 showing existing/new situation and distances to parcel boundaries
section drawing scale 1:100 with dimensions for building plans
clear written explanation/motivation of the plan
findings.conceptTimingAndFee: Municipality states initiative/concept assessment usually takes 14-16 weeks and costs at least EUR 100; exact tariff follows the current leges regulation.
findings.formalApplicationDocuments: For a final permit, Halderberge points to the submission requirements in the applicable Omgevingswet rules/Omgevingsloket. The municipal page provides minimum examples for simple non-monumental building works and states other permissions/documents may be required. The exact housing-use/splitting attachment set therefore remains activity-specific rather than guessed.
findings.participation: Omgevingsdialoog/participation can be required; municipal guidelines are part of the preparation route.
findings.bibob: For building activities a Bibob form can be required, including where building costs exceed EUR 500,000, or from EUR 50,000 in a risk category/risk area, plus a repeated-application trigger. Required Bibob attachments are then part of the application package.
findings.possibleStudies: For larger/nonconforming housing initiatives, municipality explicitly warns of costs for spatial substantiation/omgevingsplan changes and associated studies/advice; project-specific studies are determined during feasibility assessment.
findings.fees: Legesverordening Halderberge 2026 CVDR750932 is current. The 2025 regulation is withdrawn for 2026 taxable facts. Exact room-rental/splitting fees are not hard-coded without matching the correct tariff-table branch.

quality.importantScopeRule: Labour-migrant housing policy is kept separate from ordinary room rental/splitting.

remainingAllowedOnly: concrete-address/current Omgevingsplan result for ordinary room rental/splitting

exact 2026 tariff for the selected activity branch
finalResult: PASS - generic research complete. The application preparation package is strong; ordinary room-rental/splitting permission remains address/current-plan and activity dependent.
